faqs.a: We target 2005-2012 Tacoma consoles. Because original numbers vary by year, we confirm the fit from your photos and year before printing.

faqs.q: Is a printed latch as strong as the original?
faqs.a: We do not claim it matches the original. Printed layers are weakest where they pull apart, so we orient the print so the main load runs along them. PETG is tough enough for a console lid latch, and we tell you if your part looks like a poor candidate.

faqs.q: Will it survive heat in a parked truck?
faqs.a: PLA softens in a hot car, so we do not use it. We print PETG for cabins and ASA if the truck sits in strong sun for long periods.

faqs.q: How do I photograph the latch for a fit check?
faqs.a: Photograph the old latch from the front, side and underside on a plain background with a coin or ruler beside it, and the latch position on the console. Send your year and trim, and any part number on the old piece.

faqs.q: Do you make safety-related car parts?
faqs.a: No. We make interior and trim parts only, and we do not make airbag, seatbelt, brake, steering, lighting or fuel parts.
